title: Lexique 3.83
attribution: Boris New and Christophe Pallier; corpus contributors and publications are listed in UPSTREAM-README.txt.
modification: The original TSV is compressed without changes. The derived SQLite resource NFC-normalizes lemmas, deduplicates lemma/POS frequencies, sums distinct POS values, and indexes original surface-form mappings. Missing, invalid and conflicting values remain unknown. Eight source rows have no POS; their totals stay unknown while their original frequency values are retained.
